backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for a cloud storage backend that manages file metadata, blob storage, folders, sharing, favorites, trash, notifications, activity logs, and user profiles with access control mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two implemented rename features: a Rename button in the bulk action bar and a Rename menu item in the file/folder context menu, both in the My Files section.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one- to two-sentence summaries of each frontend source file, serving as a reference for the frontend codebase structure and component responsibilities.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens including background, foreground, sidebar, and chart colors.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point for the React app that mounts the app into a root div and loads the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component that configures TanStack Router with all page routes, handles Internet Identity authentication, profile setup gating, and wraps the app in QueryClient and ThemeProvider.
frontend/src/components/ActivityFeed.tsx: Card component that displays a scrollable list of recent file activities with action icons, file names, and relative timestamps, showing an empty state when no activities exist.
frontend/src/components/CreateFolderDial: Modal dialog component for creating a new folder or subfolder, with a name input, validation, and toast notifications for success or failure.
frontend/src/components/DeleteConfirmati: An alert dialog for permanently deleting selected trash items, showing file count, total size, and an optional secure wipe checkbox before confirming deletion.
frontend/src/components/DeleteFileDialog: A dialog for moving a single file to trash, allowing the user to select a retention period (30, 60, or 90 days) before confirming.
frontend/src/components/DeleteFolderConf: An alert dialog for permanently deleting one or more trashed folders, warning that all contained files and subfolders will also be irreversibly deleted.
frontend/src/components/DeleteFolderToTr: A dialog for moving a folder to trash, letting the user pick a retention period via radio buttons and calling an async onConfirm handler with the folder ID and retention nanoseconds.
frontend/src/components/ErrorBoundary.ts: A React class-based error boundary that catches runtime errors and displays a fallback UI with options to retry or reload the page.
frontend/src/components/FileFilterDropdo: A dropdown UI component providing filter controls for file name, type, date range, and size range, with an active filter count badge and a clear-all option.
frontend/src/components/FileList.tsx: A comprehensive file and folder listing component that integrates search, filtering, sorting, pagination, previews, and context-menu actions (rename, move, delete, favorite, download) for files and folders.
frontend/src/components/FilePreview.tsx: A full-screen modal component that previews files (images, videos, PDFs, text) by generating blob URLs or decoding text content, with a download button and close action.
A debounced search input component with a clear button for filtering files by name or type.
frontend/src/components/FileSortDropdown: A dropdown menu component for sorting files by name, date, size, or type, displaying the current sort field and direction with icons.
frontend/src/components/FileToolbar.tsx: A composite toolbar component combining search, filter, sort, and grid/list view-mode toggle controls for the file browser.
frontend/src/components/FileUpload.tsx: A drag-and-drop file upload component that queues multiple files, uploads them to an optional folder, and tracks recent uploads via context.
frontend/src/components/FolderBreadcrumb: A breadcrumb navigation component that shows the current folder name with a root home button, fetching folder data via a query hook.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: The sticky app header with navigation, theme toggle, unread notification badge, and a user avatar dropdown menu for profile and logout actions.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: The root layout component that composes the Header, Sidebar, and an ErrorBoundary-wrapped Outlet for page content.
frontend/src/components/LoadingTimeout.t: A wrapper component that shows a timeout error UI with a refresh button if the loading state exceeds a configurable duration (default 45 seconds).
frontend/src/components/MoveFolderDialog: A dialog component for moving a folder to a new parent destination, filtering out the folder's own descendants as invalid targets and showing a confirmation step before executing the move via the `useMoveFolder` mutation.
frontend/src/components/MoveToFolderDial: A dialog component that lets users select a destination folder (via radio buttons) and move one or more files there using the `useMoveFilesToFolder` mutation.
frontend/src/components/Notifications.ts: Displays a list of user notifications (storage warnings, share alerts, system announcements, etc.) fetched via `useGetNotifications`, with loading skeletons, error states, and click-to-mark-as-read functionality.
frontend/src/components/PaginationContro: A reusable pagination UI component that renders page navigation buttons, ellipsis for large page counts, an items-per-page selector, and a current range summary.
frontend/src/components/PinnedFiles.tsx: Displays the user's favorited/pinned files as a horizontal scrollable card list, fetched via `useGetFavorites`, with loading skeletons and empty/error states.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: A first-time profile setup form that collects a display name and optional email, then saves them via `useSaveCallerUserProfile` and calls a callback on success.
frontend/src/components/QuickActions.tsx: Renders three quick-action buttons (Upload Files, New Folder, Create Text Document) that trigger file uploads, folder creation dialog, or blank text file creation, using mutation hooks and toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/RecentActivityCa: Displays a list of recent file activities (upload, delete, restore, share) fetched via a query hook, with loading skeletons, error state, and empty state handling.
frontend/src/components/RenameFileDialog: Modal dialog for renaming a file that currently shows an informative error toast because the backend rename endpoint is not yet implemented.
frontend/src/components/RenameFolderDial: Modal dialog that allows users to rename a folder by calling the useRenameFolder mutation hook, with validation and toast feedback.
frontend/src/components/RestoreDialog.ts: Modal dialog that lets users restore selected trash items to either their original location or a custom folder path, with a radio group and optional path input.
frontend/src/components/SharedByMe.tsx: Displays a paginated, searchable list of file shares sent by the current user, supporting individual and bulk share revocation with selection checkboxes.
frontend/src/components/SharedWithMe.tsx: Displays files shared with the current user, supporting search, pagination, bulk download, preview, and per-file permission checks.
frontend/src/components/Sidebar.tsx: Renders the app's collapsible left navigation sidebar with route links, an admin link for admin users, and a storage quota indicator at the bottom.
frontend/src/components/SmartSuggestions: Shows a list of smart file suggestions based on access history, with loading skeletons and empty/error states.
Displays a storage usage card with a color-coded progress bar showing used vs. total quota in human-readable units.
frontend/src/components/StorageQuotaIndi: Compact sidebar widget showing storage usage as a small progress bar and used/total text, intended for the sidebar footer.
frontend/src/components/TrashFilters.tsx: Provides filter controls (search, file type, owner, date range, original path) for the trash view, emitting filtered TrashMetadata arrays on change.
frontend/src/components/TrashStorageIndi: Card component that shows how much storage the trash is consuming as a size and percentage of the user's total quota.
frontend/src/components/UserStorageManag: Admin component that lists all users' storage usage in a table and allows editing individual user quotas via a dialog.
frontend/src/contexts/RecentUploadsConte: Provides a React context for tracking recently uploaded files, exposing methods to add and clear uploads stored in local state.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useFileFilters.ts: Custom hook managing file filter state (name, type, date range, size range) and providing a memoized function to apply those filters to a list of FileMetadata.
frontend/src/hooks/useFileSearch.ts: Custom hook that maintains a search query string and provides a memoized function to filter FileMetadata by file name or extension.
frontend/src/hooks/useFileSorting.ts: Custom hook managing sort field and order state, providing a memoized function to sort FileMetadata by name, date, size, or type.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity authentication via AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and a React context provider for use throughout the app.
frontend/src/hooks/usePagination.ts: Generic pagination hook that tracks current page and items-per-page state, providing a function to slice any data array to the current page.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes all React Query hooks for backend interactions, including queries and mutations for files, folders, user profiles, trash, sharing, notifications, and activity logs.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Tailwind CSS and defines CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Utility module exporting a `cn` helper that merges Tailwind CSS class names using clsx and tailwind-merge.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrapping the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard page that checks caller admin status and renders summary stat cards alongside UserStorageManager and ActivityFeed components. Shows an access-denied card if the user is not an admin.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Main file manager page with folder navigation breadcrumbs, upload toggle, and a new-folder dialog. Renders a FileList for the current folder and passes folder navigation state down to child components.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home/overview dashboard page displaying storage overview, quick-action links, pinned files, recent activity, notifications, and smart suggestions in a responsive grid layout.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login page that presents feature highlights and a single Internet Identity sign-in button using the useInternetIdentity hook.
frontend/src/pages/Recent.tsx: Recent uploads page that displays files from RecentUploadsContext with search, filter, sort, pagination, bulk selection, preview, and delete capabilities.
frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx: Settings page allowing users to view account info, configure trash retention period, and toggle the app theme using next-themes.
frontend/src/pages/Shared.tsx: Shared files page with two tabs — 'Shared With Me' and 'Shared By Me' — rendering the corresponding SharedWithMe and SharedByMe components.
frontend/src/pages/Trash.tsx: React page component for the Trash view that displays deleted files and folders in a tabbed, sortable, paginated table with support for restore, permanent delete, bulk selection, and admin owner filtering.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module providing functions to read URL/hash query parameters, persist them to sessionStorage, and clean sensitive params from the URL hash without a page reload.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration that sets up dark mode, custom OKLCH-based color tokens, border radius variables, accordion keyframe animations, and registers the typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state manifest tracking the CloudVault app's version, existing implemented features (bulk and context-menu Rename in My Files), and a pending feature request to add Rename before Move in both the bulk action bar and three-dot menu.
